02Who we are

Built for environments where trust, clarity and execution matter.

Rhanamerzy Concepts is a strategic advisory, public relations and solutions company. We work with organisations operating across international markets.

We combine strategic thinking, stakeholder understanding and practical delivery. Our role is to help clients move from uncertainty to clear, workable outcomes.

Strategy grounded in context. Engagement built around outcomes.

  1. 01

    Strategic Advisory

    Clear direction for complex institutional, commercial and cross-border decisions.

  2. 02

    Public Relations and Strategic Communications

    Credible narratives and disciplined messaging that hold up across different audiences and markets.

  3. 03

    Stakeholder Engagement

    Structured engagement with the people, institutions and communities that shape outcomes.

08Leadership

Mercy Alexander

Managing Director · Rhanamerzy Concepts

Mercy Alexander leads Rhanamerzy Concepts. She advises leaders in government and business on the relationships, decisions and communication that shape their work.

Profile

Mercy Alexander founded Rhanamerzy Concepts to give organisations a clear and dependable partner in complex operating environments. Before founding the firm she worked in strategic communications and public affairs, advising institutions and businesses on how to engage the people and organisations that shape their outcomes.

Clients know her for careful preparation, candour and a steady hand in difficult rooms. Away from the work she reads widely and gives her time to causes close to her.
